v3_guide.A2: Enter one material per row. Hover over any header for its instructions.
v3_guide.B4: N:S cover the six complete calendar months before the plan month. For weekly plans, use the month containing Monday. T (current sales) and U (shortage) are required; enter 0 when applicable.
v3_guide.B5: Leave L, M and AC:AM untouched. They provide an offline preview. The system recalculates each line using the standard attached to the plan.
v3_guide.B6: K is optional. AN:AQ are recorded during online review and revision; leave them blank on upload.
v3_guide.B7: Fill in X (sea) or Y (air) or both. Enter 0 for no replenishment. In the full V3 template a blank side counts as 0.
v3_guide.A8: Replacement rates, stock targets and review standards
v3_guide.B9: An approved warehouse rate is matched by material number. Otherwise use the source rate.
v3_guide.B10: When coverage-based calculation is active the system calculates the targets. Source targets can come from the warehouse standard or the plan.
v3_guide.B11: These rules drive the offline Excel preview. Online review uses the published standard attached to the plan. Maintain rates and thresholds under Management → Review standards.
v3_guide.B14: Open the draft, select Import plan, choose your file, check the row count and confirm. Reference data can also be edited in the line details.
v3_guide.B15: The reviewer records decisions (AN) and optional comments (AQ). After return the planner revises quantities (AO); the reviewer records a new decision (AP).
v3_guide.B16: The first 2,000 rows include preview formulas. Fill the blue columns down for offline previews, or upload directly for system calculation. The limit is 10,000 material lines per plan.
